name: Don't Miss The Train! 🚆
desc:
🚇 Welcome aboard — grab your transit pass and step through the turnstiles!
🎒 Find an open seat, hold onto the handrail, and get ready to ride the rails.
🗽 Take the express line all the way to New York and see what awaits when you exit the station!
🌍 Replay your commute to unlock and visit even more iconic subway lines around the world.
Which station will your next ride take you to? 👀

llm.loop: pass the turnstiles -> find a seat and ride the subway -> reach New York -> unlock other subway lines -> or pay to troll, play security or drive the train
llm.objectives: ride to the destination and unlock lines
llm.instructions: step through the turnstiles, ride, replay to unlock lines
unique: third wait-in-line template game seen today
llm.thumbnails: realistic NYC subway car; a panicked kid sprinting for the closing doors
llm.complexity_notes: queue template with a moving train
